text:
ida: opened a tiny PR to clarify the generate parameter naming mismatch: some examples use `stop` (array) while others use `stop_sequences` (legacy). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1542

pat: Which SDKs still use the old name?

ida: JS snippets in the examples folder use `stop`, Python SDK already accepts `stop_sequences` as alias but examples show `stop_sequences`. OpenAPI has `stop` in the request body but components/params mention `stop_sequences` in a note.

syl: Oof. Also streaming SSE docs show an event `stop_reached: true` and a `stop` array in the final payload which confused the JS streaming client (it expected `stop_sequences` and treated the payload as error).

ida: My PR standardizes on `stop` as the canonical field (array of strings) in OpenAPI and all examples, and adds `x-sdk-alias: stop_sequences` so generated clients accept the legacy name. It also clarifies SSE: incremental chunks may emit `stop_index` when a token triggers a stop and the final object includes `stop` array with matched sequences.

pat: Can you add a tiny migration blurb: "If you passed stop_sequences before, the SDKs will accept it for one release but please switch to `stop`."

ida: Done. Also normalized examples so curl/py/js show the same `stop` array shape. Example curl:```\ncurl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \\n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\n  -d '{"model":"redwood-1","input":"write haiku","stop":["\"--END--\""]}'\n```\n\nleo: For SSE streaming, let's be explicit: clients should handle `stop_index` events and treat final `stop` array as authoritative. Add a note that proxies may reorder headers/events so prefer final `stop` for deterministic behavior.

ida: Added SSE example showing incremental `delta` events, a `stop_index` event, and final `done` event containing `stop` array. Also added OpenAPI `components/parameters/Stop` and `x-sdk-alias` entries.

docs-bot: Deploy preview: https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood.ai/1542  examples and SSE docs updated.

syl: I'll update integration tests for streaming client to assert both `stop` and legacy `stop_sequences` accepted.

pat: LGTM. Merge once CI is green. :shipit:

---

Reviewer checklist in PR desc:
- [ ] Update OpenAPI field name to `stop` (done)
- [ ] Add x-sdk-alias for `stop_sequences` (done)
- [ ] Normalize curl/py/js examples (done)
- [ ] Update SSE docs and add stop_index example (done)
- [ ] Run codegen and smoke-test SDKs (pending CI)

If anyone finds other inconsistent param names on the generate page ping me and I'll sweep them into this PR.
__notes: Slack thread: short docs coordination about standardizing stop vs stop_sequences naming and SSE behavior across examples and SDKs
